One endpoint, every model.

Point the SDK you already use at one URL. Each call goes to the model you name, or the cheapest one that passes a check you set (a test, a schema, a judge), and every call is recorded with what it cost. Over a plain key you get routing, checks, one bill and the record.

from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.massrelay.ai/v1", api_key="YOUR_RELAY_KEY")
client.chat.completions.create(model="auto", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}])
